name: What is the process for getting a home addition approved in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a home addition approved in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for a home addition in Daly City typically begins with design and architectural plans. Once plans are developed, they must be submitted to the City of Daly City Planning Department for review and approval, ensuring compliance with zoning codes and building ordinances. Following planning approval, structural and other technical plans go through the Building Division for permits. This usually involves several rounds of review and may require neighborhood notifications. A general contractor can help navigate these municipal requirements efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Getting a home addition approved in Daly City involves submitting architectural and structural plans to the Planning and Building Divisions for review and permits.
